title: Kenyan Yogurt Stir Fry
description: A refreshing and light Kenyan-inspired stir fry made with yogurt, perfect for a quick lunch or snack.

ingredients.name: Kenyan Vegetable Mix
ingredients.notes: any combination of bell peppers, carrots, green beans, and onions

instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of fry in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Kenyan Vegetable Mix and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the Stir Fry Sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the Plain Yogurt and a pinch of salt.
Add the cooked vegetable mixture to the yogurt bowl and stir until well combined.
Serve the Kenyan Yogurt Stir Fry over Jazzy Jasmine Rice.
Garnish with additional Stir Fry Sauce, if desired.
